target: Agent 4 changed/candidate artifact validation checkpoint after Agent10 heartbeat

validator_commands.command: $cutoff=(Get-Item reports\agent4-validator-prereq-packet-sweep-after-agent6-source-family-boundary-prereq-proof-2026-06-06.json).LastWriteTime; Get-ChildItem reports,data\control -File | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -gt $cutoff } | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 50 FullName,LastWriteTime,Length | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 2

validator_commands.observed_summary: Agent10 loop heartbeat only; status running pulse; boundary says it must not edit Agent6 dockets, Agent6 queue/status files, public/generated pages, source/lexical/route/control data, or Agent6/7 validator scripts.

exact_blockers.command_list_needed: Exact validator/prereq command for the next changed package or candidate artifact.
exact_blockers.expected_output_schema: Agent4 proof packet with changed_input_artifact, validator_commands including timeout_ms/result, counts, exact blockers, handoff_owner, stop_condition, and non_acceptance_boundary.
exact_blockers.validator_gate: Run only an existing named validator for the changed package/input, then validate the Agent4 packet with scripts\validate_agent4_validator_prereq_packet.mjs.
exact_blockers.package_owner: Agent 10 release/package intake or the upstream package-producing agent for the next changed artifact.
exact_blockers.agent6_boundary_trigger: Only after a concrete boundary-ready packet exists and Agent 6 review is explicitly needed.
exact_blockers.next_harness_gap: A deterministic changed-package intake selector could distinguish heartbeat/status files from changed package artifacts and emit the next exact validator command without manual inspection.
exact_blockers.stop_condition: Stop after recording that the only newer file is an Agent10 heartbeat/status note, not a changed package input.

handoff_owner: Agent 4 for changed-input-only validation discipline; Agent 10 or upstream package owner must provide the next changed package/input.
next_safe_action: Wake on exact changed package/input path, command list, expected output/schema, validator/gate, package owner, Agent 6 boundary trigger, and stop condition.
stop_condition: Return one exact changed-input blocker and do not rerun unchanged validators.
non_acceptance_boundary: No source, provenance, license, legal, Definition, answer, product, publication, public/runtime, route publication, or release acceptance.
No accepted gloss, accepted text, public reader output, public runtime mutation, or release action.
